'''Shasa Tiel''' was an ambitious [[Ishi Tib]] [[accountant]] who was in charge of the vast fortune belonging to the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="AEYNTK" /> Tiel was sleeping on Jabba's dais in the Hutt's [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] when [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] attempted to [[Rescue of Han Solo|free]] the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] from [[carbonite]] while disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]]. The Ishi Tib was also present for the arrival of the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]], who tried to negotiate with Jabba for the release of Solo, but ended up being dropped into the Hutt's [[rancor]] pit. Tiel later traveled on ''[[Khetanna]]'' to see the planned execution of Skywalker, Solo and the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]].<ref name="ROTJ" />
